title: Why One Vaccine Shot Is Quietly Erasing A Cancer
hook: One shot is quietly wiping out a cancer, and almost nobody noticed.
closing: A simple shot in childhood can prevent a cancer decades later. Ask your doctor about it.
question: Did you know this vaccine worked?

segments.say: Nine in ten cervical cancers come from one virus, HPV. So stopping that single virus could stop most of the disease.
Teen girls carrying that virus dropped by about 85 percent. Fewer infections now means fewer cancers later.
Girls vaccinated young cut their cervical cancer risk by 88 percent. That is proof the shot stops cancer itself, not just the virus.
